mapper.sql: SELECT intent_id::text, tenant_id::text, run_id::text, invocation_id, tool_id, tool_version, args_fingerprint, approval_id, intent_state, created_at, updated_at FROM cap_execution_intent
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cap_execution_intent (intent_id, tenant_id, run_id, invocation_id, tool_id, tool_version, args_fingerprint, approval_id, intent_state, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{intentId}::uuid, #{tenantId}::uuid, #{runId}::uuid, #{invocationId}, #{toolId}, #{toolVersion}, #{argsFingerprint}, #{approvalId}, #{intentState}::cap_intent_state, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, invocation_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE cap_execution_intent SET intent_state = #{toState}::cap_intent_state, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND invocation_id = #{invocationId} AND intent_state = #{expectedFrom}::cap_intent_state
mapper.select: WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND intent_state IN ('RESERVED', 'INTENT_SUBMITTED') ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
